chapter.verse: Sabbath khit, nipikal ni masani zingsang khuavak kuanin Magdala khuami Mary leh Mary a dang khat, han ah daihawh va pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin, en un, thakhat thu-in nakpitak zinling vat hi. A hang pen Topa' vanmi khat vantung pan hong kumsukin suangtumpi likkhia-in tua tungah tu ahih man hi.
Ama' mel khuaphia tawh kibang a, a puante zong vuk bangin paak hi.
Hancingte zong amah kihta lua uh ahih manin liing gawpin silum dek uh hi.
Ahi zongin tua vanmi in numeite' kiangah, “Lau kei un. A hang pen singlamteh tunga kikhailum Jesu na zonlam uh kong thei hi.
A gensa mah bangin amah kithokiksak khin ahih manin amah hih lai-ah om lo hi. Hong pai unla a kisialna mun hong en un.

Tua ciangin manlangtak va pai unla, ‘Misite lakpan amah thokik khin hi. En un, note' ma-in Galilee ah Jesu pai ding a, tua takah amah na mu ding uh hi,’ ci-in a nungzuite' kiangah va gen un. Thei ta un, kong gen khin hi,” ci hi.
Numeite zong hankhuk nusia pahin nungzuite' kiangah thu ko dingin launa leh nakpi nuamna tawh tai samsam uh hi.
Ahih hangin, en un, Jesu in amaute dawntuah a, “Thupha ngah ta un!” ci-in hopih hi. Amau zong Jesu naih uh a, a khete pomin bia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in amau' kiangah, “Lau kei un. Pai unla ka sanggamte Galilee a pai nadingun va gen un. Amaute in tua takah kei hong mu ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Amaute a pai laitak, en un, hancingte kimkhat khuapi sungah pai uh a, thupiang khempeuh siampi liante' kiangah gen uh hi.
Siampi liante zong Jew makaite tawh kimukhawmin a kikup khit uh ciangin galkapte' kiangah sum a hoihkhop khat pia uh a,
“Mite' kiangah, ‘Zan ka ihmut kalun a nungzuite hong pai-in amah gukhia uh hi,’ ci-in gen un.
Hih thu, gam-uk mangpa in a zakkhakleh zong a lungkim dong ka na hopih ding uh a, no kong buaisak kei ding uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Galkapte in zong tua sumte la-in a kisawl bangin hih uh hi. Tua hi a, amau' gen teng mah tuni dongin Jew mite lakah kigengen lai hi.
Tu-in nungzui sawmlekhatte Galilee gam, Jesu' vaikhakna mual ah pai uh hi.
Jesu a muh uh ciangin bia uh a, ahi zongin kimkhat in muanglah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu hong pai-in amaute' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: “Vantung leh leitunga om uktheihna thu khempeuh kei hong kipia khinzo hi.
Tua ahih manin pai unla, minam khempeuh nungzui suaksak un. Tua ciangin Pa, Tapa, Kha Siangtho min tawh amaute baptize un.
Note' tunga kong thupiak khempeuh a zuih nadingun zong hilhcian un. En un, khanghun bei dongin note tawh kong omkhawm hi.”
